title: Mindless breathing rings fit narrow phones and timer controls have comfortable touch targets
detail: The breathing SVG was fixed at288px while a320px timer has272px after48px gutters. The visualizer and its live parent now shrink to available width with the original288/320px caps, preserving the square viewBox. Small pattern/duration/audio chips and Details controls now have44px minimum height; masthead mode/close use the canonical tap-target primitive. No min-width was forced onto six-column duration grids, so larger targets do not create a new narrow overflow. 80 focused timer tests5 suites and ESLint passed; actual320px rendered timer/physical touch review remains required.

verify.evidence: Pending integrated browser verification at320x568 and390x844: open Tune Out/Breathe, verify ring bounds remain within viewport, Details and settings reachable,44px vertical controls do not overlap, sticky Pause/Finish and setup Start remain visible/reachable; switch Get Moving and review duration grids. Verify desktop ring caps unchanged. Source timing/math tests passed but do not prove rendered geometry.
